s1.desc: an empty space with a plain pale grey background

beats.text: Pax waddles in from the left while Polly waddles in from the right, and they meet in the middle
Pax reaches behind his back and pulls out a small wrapped gift with a bow while Polly looks at him
Pax holds the gift out to Polly with a smile while she raises a flipper to her cheek in delight
Polly takes the gift from Pax with both flippers
Polly hugs the gift to her chest with blushing cheeks while Pax smiles at her
Polly leans in and nuzzles Pax cheek to cheek, holding the gift, as they both close their eyes and blush

spans.notes: plain flat background, so ECC has no fit; judged by eye: the two walk toward each other from opposite edges (a pan would move both the same way), feet and shadows stay the same size, and compare 28/118 puts Pax's shadow at the same place. Both are partly cut off by the side edges at f0 and fully in by ~f4. Top third and bottom fifth are perfectly uniform on every frame f0-118 (pixel std 0): no caption or watermark

phone-screen inserts to the end, each a hard cut (f119, f143, f167, f191, f215): the iFin (tuft on top) fills the picture showing a chat of voice messages with a Pax avatar in the header (f119-142), a call screen with on-screen text and a heart (f143-166), a text chat with Pax's avatar (f167-190), a recents call list (f191-214), and a lock screen whose wallpaper shows Pax and Polly with a notification (f215-248). Also lead_copy (avatars, wallpaper) and on-screen text throughout
